about_the_game:
Alix is ​​a retro-RPG adventure game in pixel art. The story takes place on the island of Auralia, which lived in peace until the day Romain wakes up from a terrible nightmare. When he wakes up, his little sister has disappeared, as well as all the animals on the island.

In this game, you will discover great quests, you will have to solve puzzles, defeat the monsters who invaded the island, use spells, gain XP, and travel along the multiple islands of the archipel.

Alix, be strong, your brother is coming!

name: Alix Demo
short_description: Alix is ​​a retro-RPG pixel art adventure game, in which you must find and save your little sister, discover the mystery of the island of Auralia, and revive all the animals of the archipel that have disappeared. Puzzles, fights and quests are all there, waiting for you !
